posts.title: Six panels, one afternoon
posts.excerpt: Rafael Ortega ran the same nesting job six times for six workshops on Day 2 of the 2025 edition.
posts.content:
On Day 2 of the 2025 edition, Rafael Ortega ran the same nesting job on stand A-14 six times in one afternoon, once for each of six workshops that had asked to see it. Each visitor brought their own part list, and each run was timed from the first sheet loaded to the last part stacked. The point was not speed alone: buyers wanted to see how the router held its tolerances from the first cut to the sixth.

The fair repeats that idea in 2027 with 62 machines running under power in Hall 4 from 9 to 11 March.
